selection: Generate the fixed pool once; sort by SHA256(seed,source,split,group,doc_id); whole-history fit and split-signature rejection precede capped selection. Stop the category at its first otherwise eligible item that would exceed its cap. Never refill a stopped category or redistribute unused targets.
split: Authored construction families and all their paraphrases/operation/number/observation contrasts stay in one split. Reject development histories sharing any complete tool call or complete parameter tuple with retained training histories; do not refill.
provenance: Actual allowed operations execute independent FixtureSession calls. Counterfactual numeric/error observations are explicitly synthetic recorded fixture bindings; no synthetic observation is labeled ordinary execution. Denied-tool examples issue no forbidden proposal.
